'''Admiral Snackbar''' was an dining establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Advertisements were put up in the town of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] in order to promote it. Admiral Snackbar's slogan was "it's a frap!". It was located next to [[Game Go/Legends|Game Go]], right across the street from [[Dr. Evazan Cosmetic Surgery/Legends|Dr. Evazan Cosmetic Surgery]], and near the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] diner. When [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] visited the town at some point during the Clone Wars, the establishment was closed down; a sign on the building said "out of business".

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Another Admiral Snackbar was located in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its slogan was, "It's a Snack!".
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
The establishment name is a pun on [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], while the slogan is a reference to his "it's a trap!" line in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].
